lines.en: label slumparty:
scene street_noon
I wound up sitting in the office for a good hour after Makoto left, but it seems that my services as the least qualified guidance counselor to ever exist are not all that sought after.
lines.zh: Makoto 走后，我在办公室里又坐了足足一个小时，不过看来我这个史上最不合格的升学顾问所提供的服务，似乎并没有那么抢手。

lines.en: But hey, at least I won't have to worry about that for the next couple days.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，至少接下来几天我都不用再为这事操心了。

lines.en: Tomorrow is Saturday, so I should finally have some free time to actually do things I want rather than just...hang around teenage girls all day.
lines.zh: 明天就是周六，所以我终于该有点属于自己的空闲时间，去做点自己真正想做的事，而不是整天……陪在高中女生身边。

lines.en: Which, to be fair, is exactly what I'm going to be doing anyway. Just this time it will be out of my own free will and not determined by a schedule.
lines.zh: 平心而论，我要做的其实还是这回事。只不过这一次是出于我自己的意愿，而不是被日程表推着走。

lines.en: Either that or I won't be able to find anyone at all and I'll spend the whole day just aimlessly wandering around an unfamiliar town.
lines.zh: 要么就是我一个人都找不着，然后在陌生的镇子上漫无目的地晃上一整天。

lines.en: Something tells me my luck won't be {i}that{/i} horrible, though.
lines.zh: 不过我有种预感，我的运气还不至于差到{i}那个地步{/i}。

lines.en: I mean...look where I ended up. This world is every man's dream.
lines.zh: 我是说……看看我如今身在何处吧。这世界是每个男人的梦想。

lines.en: There are millions of people who would kill to walk even a day in my brand new shoes, and I'll be damned if I don't start walking as far as I can as fast I can.
lines.zh: 有成千上万的人愿意为了穿上我这双新鞋走哪怕一天而杀人，而我要是不趁现在走得越远越快，那才叫该死。

lines.en: The only question is how I'm going to leverage this new life to get what I want out of it.
lines.zh: 唯一的问题是，我要怎么利用这崭新的人生，从中得到我想要的东西。

lines.en: There are ten girls in my class right now. And if what Ami said yesterday is true, more could show up at any time.
lines.zh: 现在我的班上有十个女孩。而如果 Ami 昨天说的是真的，随时还会有更多出现。

lines.en: That said, the best course of action would be to try and...balance out my time with all of them, right?
lines.zh: 话虽如此，最稳妥的做法应该是试着……把时间平均分配给她们所有人，对吧？

lines.en: Focusing too much on one will just wind up drawing attention to us. And even if most of the girls I've encountered so far are...{i}eccentric,{/i} I doubt any of them would be okay with-
lines.zh: 只盯着一个人，到头来只会把注意力引到我们身上。而且就算我目前遇到的这些女孩大多都……{i}性情古怪{/i}，我怀疑她们中任何一个都不会接受——

lines.en: Well, pretty much {i}any{/i} of the things I want to do at this point in time.
lines.zh: 嗯，也就是眼下我几乎想做的{i}任何{/i}一件事。

lines.en: I'm sure the line will be different for everyone...I just have to figure out how thin or thick those lines are and the best methods to cross over them.
lines.zh: 每个人的底线肯定都不一样……我只要摸清那些线到底有多细、多厚，以及跨越它们的最佳方法就行了。

lines.en: But that's a problem I'll figure out how to deal with once I actually encounter it.
lines.zh: 不过那是等我真正遇到时再去想办法解决的问题。

lines.en: For now, I should be heading home.
lines.zh: 现在，我该回家了。

lines.en: I remember Ami mentioning that she was going to have Ayane and Maya stay over tonight, but I doubt that means I'll be able to spend any time with either of them.
lines.zh: 我记得 Ami 说过今晚要让 Ayane 和 Maya 留宿，但我不觉得这就意味着我能跟她们中任何一个待上一会儿。

lines.en: They're teenage girls after all. Chances are they'll just be...gossipping in Ami's room or whatever it is girls that age do.
lines.zh: 毕竟她们是十几岁的女孩。多半只是在 Ami 的房间里……聊八卦，或者做那个年纪的女孩会做的任何事。

lines.en: Maybe I'll just go to sleep early tonight? The closer I get to having any free time, the better. And Saturday is less than twelve hours away at this point.
lines.zh: 也许今晚我就早点睡吧？越接近自由时间越好。而且周六现在算起来已经不到十二个小时了。

lines.en: scene black
Yeah...
lines.zh: 是啊……

lines.en: I think that's what I'll wind up doing tonight.
lines.zh: 我想今晚我大概就会这么过了。

lines.en: scene lr_noon
I let myself into the house after realizing that Ami forgot to lock the door.
lines.zh: 发现 Ami 忘了锁门，我便自己进了屋。

lines.en: And while my initial instinct is to storm into her room and reprimand her for enabling a situation that could result in her being raped and killed while I am not home, I decide against it.
lines.zh: 虽然我的第一反应是冲进她房间，训斥她制造出了这种我不在家时可能被人强暴杀害的局面，但我还是决定算了。

lines.en: Though, I {i}do{/i} like the idea of being able to embarrass a girl I am apparently the guardian of in front of her friends.
lines.zh: 不过，我{i}确实{/i}挺喜欢在我名义上监护的这个女孩的朋友面前让她难堪这个主意。

lines.en: I also, however, have not ruled out the idea of sleeping with her yet. And I feel that embarrassing her now would only serve to inhibit that budding desire of mine.
lines.zh: 但我同样也还没打消跟她上床的念头。而且我觉得，现在让她难堪只会抑制我这份正在萌芽的欲望。

lines.en: : What?! No way! You did not!
lines.zh: : 什么？！不会吧！你才没有！

lines.en: Yeah.
lines.zh: 好吧。

lines.en: I'll just let girls be girls tonight.
lines.zh: 今晚我就让女孩们做女孩吧。

lines.en: I don't have to involve myself in {i}everything.{/i}
lines.zh: 我不用{i}什么事{/i}都掺和一脚。

lines.en: Sometimes the best thing to do is just sit back and let things happen on their own.
lines.zh: 有时候最好的做法就是袖手旁观，让事情自己发展。

lines.en: scene black
Not just because the cogs in the background are already powering a machine built to pleasure me, but because being alone can be just as fulfilling as being {i}with{/i} someone.
lines.zh: 不只是因为我背后那些齿轮已经在驱动一台专门取悦我的机器，更因为独处可以和{i}与人相伴{/i}一样令人满足。

lines.en: When I'm alone, I can fantasize about all I want. And, between you and I-
lines.zh: 一个人的时候，我想怎么幻想都行。而且，这话我只跟你说——

lines.en: I have very quickly learned that being a high school teacher comes with its fair share of fantasies.
lines.zh: 我很快就明白了，当高中老师会伴随着相当多的幻想。

lines.en: I hope no one minds if I take a few of those fantasies into the bathroom for a little while.
lines.zh: 希望没人介意我把其中几个幻想带进洗手间待上一会儿。

lines.en: {i}Meanwhile...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}与此同时……{/i}

lines.en: scene sleepover1
: And {i}that's{/i} why I was permanently banned from the convenience store near the school!
lines.zh: : 所以{i}这就是{/i}为什么我被学校附近那家便利店永久列入了黑名单！

lines.en: scene sleepover2
: Well, that was...certainly a story.
lines.zh: : 嗯……那可真是……一段故事啊。

lines.en: : Umm...how many convenience stores have you been banned from now, Ayane? Six? Seven?
lines.zh: : 呃……Ayane，你现在已经被多少家便利店拉黑了？六家？七家？

lines.en: : Something like that, but it's not really a big deal since DoorDash exists and I can just get anything I want sent right to my dorm.
lines.zh: : 差不多吧，不过其实也没什么大不了的，因为有 DoorDash 在，我想要什么都能直接送到宿舍来。

lines.en: : Yes, please brag more about how rich you are. It is a thing that we very much enjoy hearing about.
lines.zh: : 对，请再多炫耀一点你有钱这件事。这可是我们非常爱听的。

lines.en: scene sleepover3
: Hey! How is taking advantage of the DoorDash Dash Pass for the low, low cost of $9.99 per month bragging about being rich?!
lines.zh: : 喂！用上 DoorDash Dash Pass，每月只要低至 9.99 美元，这怎么算炫耀有钱了？！

lines.en: : That's right, Maya! The DoorDash Dash Pass is so cheap right now that virtually anyone can afford it.
lines.zh: : 说得对，Maya！DoorDash Dash Pass 现在便宜得几乎人人都负担得起。

lines.en: : And with new restaurants being added to Dash Pass every day, there has never been a better time to take advantage of the opportunity.
lines.zh: : 而且每天都有新的餐厅加入 Dash Pass，现在正是享受这个机会的最佳时机。

lines.en: {i}Lessons in Love is not sponsored by nor affiliated with DoorDash.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Lessons in Love 未接受 DoorDash 赞助，也不存在任何隶属关系。{/i}

lines.en: : What's going on with you two? That's the third advertisement you've spontaneously broken into tonight.
lines.zh: : 你们俩怎么回事？这已经是今晚你们第三次突然插入广告了。

lines.en: scene sleepover3r
: Is that really it? It felt like more.
lines.zh: : 真的只有三次吗？感觉不止啊。

lines.en: : No wonder your family is so rich if you can't even make it through a sleepover without advertising some sort of...app or something.
lines.zh: : 难怪你家那么有钱，连过个夜都忍不住要打点什么……App 之类的广告。

lines.en: : Excuse me, Maya, but my family is rich because my father invented unpoppable bubble wrap. And I am very tired of reminding you about this.
lines.zh: : 恕我直言，Maya，我家有钱是因为我父亲发明了不会破的泡泡纸。而且我真的很烦一遍遍提醒你这件事。

lines.en: : I am very tired of being reminded...
lines.zh: : 我也很烦一遍遍被提醒……

lines.en: {i}Hi, there! It's your favorite narrator here to confirm that what Ayane just said is true!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你好呀！是你最喜欢的旁白，来确认一下 Ayane 刚才说的都是真的！{/i}

lines.en: {i}The Amamiya family is set for life due to the innovative and fun-destroying mind of her father.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Amamiya 家靠着她父亲那既富创造力又专门摧毁乐趣的脑袋，这辈子都不愁吃穿了。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Why would anyone ever think of creating unpoppable bubble wrap, you ask?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你问为什么会有人想到要做不会破的泡泡纸？{/i}

lines.en: {i}Good question!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}问得好！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Unfortunately, I have no idea.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}可惜，我也不知道。{/i}

lines.en: {i}But what I do know is that the answer will be revealed in the upcoming Lessons in Love expansion pack, “A World Without Bubbles!”{/i}
lines.zh: {i}但我知道的是，答案将在即将推出的 Lessons in Love 资料片《没有泡泡的世界！》中揭晓。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Pre-order your copy from GameStop today and unlock three bonus costumes for Ayane’s dad.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}今天就去 GameStop 预购，还能解锁 Ayane 爸爸的三套奖励服装。{/i}

lines.en: scene sleepover4
: Why would someone go out of their way to just...make a normal shipping product worse?
lines.zh: : 为什么会有人特意去……把一个正常的包装用品做得这么糟糕？

lines.en: : Especially when you can visit your local FedEx store and ship anything you want for-
lines.zh: : 尤其是你明明可以去附近的 FedEx 门店寄任何你想寄的东西——

lines.en: : Ami, stop. Ayane, tell us more about why your dad is suddenly an evil human being who hates plastic bubbles.
lines.zh: : Ami，打住。Ayane，再多说说你爸为什么突然变成了个讨厌塑料泡泡的恶人。

lines.en: scene sleepover5
: Uhh...better idea: how about we {i}don't{/i} talk about my dad?
lines.zh: : 呃……我有个更好的主意：我们能不能{i}别{/i}聊我爸了？

lines.en: : I kind of wanted tonight to be relaxing and fun, and it's not going to be {i}either{/i} of those things if I'm forced to talk about my arch nemesis.
lines.zh: : 我今晚还挺想过得轻松开心点的，要是我被迫聊我的宿敌，那这{i}两样{/i}都别想了。

lines.en: scene sleepover6
: Nemesis? Isn’t that taking things a little too far?
lines.zh: : 宿敌？这么说是不是有点太夸张了？

lines.en: : He's still your dad at the end of the day. Even if he's a giant jerk butt now.
lines.zh: : 他归根到底还是你爸啊。哪怕他现在是个大混蛋。

lines.en: : Are you kidding? All he does is drink whiskey and listen to smooth jazz now.
lines.zh: : 开什么玩笑？他现在整天就知道喝威士忌、听轻爵士。

lines.en: : That is super villain behavior, Ami. He is clearly my nemesis.
lines.zh: : 那可是超级反派的行径啊，Ami。他显然就是我的宿敌。

lines.en: : You have a strange idea of what constitutes a “super villain” but okay.
lines.zh: : 你对“超级反派”的定义挺奇怪的，不过随便你。

lines.en: : Smooth jazz? Is normal jazz...too rough for some people or something?
lines.zh: : 轻爵士？普通爵士对某些人来说……太粗糙了吗？

lines.en: scene sleepover8
: It’s seriously unbearable. Like, he won't even {i}listen{/i} to my favorite song when I ask him to.
lines.zh: : 那真的难听到让人受不了。比如，我让他放我最喜欢的那首歌，他连那都不肯{i}放{/i}。

lines.en: : I have heard your favorite song and want to make it formally known that I am on his side.
lines.zh: : 我听过你最喜欢的那首歌，在此正式声明：我站他那边。

lines.en: : That's fine because Ami is still on my side. Right, Ami?
lines.zh: : 没关系，因为 Ami 还站在我这边。对吧，Ami？

lines.en: : Umm...
scene sleepover8r
: Ahh! You’re so lucky! You get to live with Sensei and all I get is a borderline alcoholic with poor taste in music!
lines.zh: : 啊！你太幸运了！你能跟 Sensei 住在一起，而我只有一个品味糟糕的准酒鬼！

lines.en: scene sleepover9
: What is your fascination with him, anyway? He’s just some...normal old guy who also happens to be our teacher.
lines.zh: : 你到底迷他哪一点啊？他不过是个……普通的老男人，碰巧还是我们的老师。

lines.en: : Is that really all you look for in a partner? Age and...{i}age?{/i}
lines.zh: : 你找对象真的只看这些吗？年纪和……{i}年纪{/i}？

lines.en: : Maya, are you ever going to warm up to him?...
lines.zh: : Maya，你到底会不会对他改观啊？……

lines.en: : You two have known each other for years and I've only really seen him be nice to you.
lines.zh: : 你们俩认识这么多年了，而我只看过他对你好。

lines.en: : Just being nice isn’t a good enough reason to like someone. If it was, I’d like pretty much everybody. Do you think I have the energy for that?
lines.zh: : 光是待人友善不足以成为喜欢一个人的理由。如果可以的话，我大概会喜欢上所有人。你觉得我有那个精力吗？

lines.en: scene sleepover10
: It's hard to put into words...but my fascination with him runs way deeper than just his age and his occupation.
lines.zh: : 很难用语言表达……但我对他的迷恋远不止他的年纪和职业。

lines.en: : Sensei...is everything I like in a man. No- he's everything I like in a {i}person.{/i}
lines.zh: : Sensei……具备我喜欢一个男人的一切。不——他具备我喜欢{i}一个人{/i}的一切。

lines.en: : He’s smart...and he’s kind...and he’s funny...and-
lines.zh: : 他聪明……又温柔……又风趣……而且——

lines.en: : Twice your age.
lines.zh: : 年纪是你的两倍。

lines.en: scene sleepover11
: Age is just a number, Maya! If Sensei wants me, Sensei can have me!
lines.zh: : 年纪只是个数字而已，Maya！如果 Sensei 想要我，那 Sensei 就可以得到我！

lines.en: scene sleepover12
: I really don't think you should be the one saying {i}age is just a number{/i} in this situation...
lines.zh: : 我真的觉得{i}这句话{/i}不该由你来说……

lines.en: : Besides, it won't be weird at all a few years from now.
lines.zh: : 再说了，过几年就一点都不奇怪了。

lines.en: : No, it definitely still will.
lines.zh: : 不，到那时候肯定还是一样奇怪。

lines.en: : Nuh-uh! We'll have a house...a dog...seven children-
lines.zh: : 才不会！我们会有一栋房子……一只狗……七个孩子——

lines.en: scene sleepover13
: Seven?!
lines.zh: : 七个？！

lines.en: : Just what the heck do you think you're planning on doing with my uncle, Ayane?!
lines.zh: : 你到底打算拿我叔叔怎么样啊，Ayane？！

lines.en: : Do you really think I would allow {i}seven{/i} children?!
lines.zh: : 你真以为我会允许{i}七个{/i}孩子吗？！

lines.en: : Wording it like that makes it sound like you'd be okay with less...
lines.zh: : 你这话说得像是少几个你就能接受了……

lines.en: : Answer me, damn it! What are you planning on doing, Ayane?!
lines.zh: : 回答我，该死的！你到底在打什么算盘，Ayane？！

lines.en: scene sleepover14
: Showering him with my unconditional love!
lines.zh: : 用我无条件的爱把他淹没！

lines.en: scene sleepover15
: And what if he doesn't {i}want{/i} your unconditional love?!
lines.zh: : 那如果他并不{i}想要{/i}你无条件的爱呢？！

lines.en: scene sleepovergun
: Then I end my life the only way I know how.
lines.zh: : 那我就用我唯一知道的方式结束自己的生命。

lines.en: scene sleepover16
: You really need to stop carrying that thing around. You're going to accidentally hurt someone one day.
lines.zh: : 你真的别再随身带那玩意儿了。总有一天你会不小心伤到人的。

lines.en: : Where did you even get that? Aren't guns illegal in Japan?
lines.zh: : 你从哪儿搞来的？枪在日本不是非法的吗？

lines.en: scene sleepover17
: Nothing is illegal when you're rich, unfortunately.
lines.zh: : 有钱就没什么事是非法的，很遗憾。

lines.en: : What do you mean {i}unfortunately?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}很遗憾{/i}是什么意思？

lines.en: : Well, the getting anything you want part isn't unfortunate. But the being rich part kind of {i}is{/i} in a...really roundabout way that you can't really complain about without people thinking you suck.
lines.zh: : 嗯，想买什么就能买什么那部分不遗憾。但是有钱这件事，在某种……很绕的层面上{i}确实{/i}挺遗憾的，绕到你根本没法抱怨，一抱怨别人就觉得你这人很差劲。

lines.en: : Like, the only person in the mansion who even pays attention to me anymore is Geoffrey. And you know how Geoffrey is.
lines.zh: : 就好比，宅邸里现在唯一还会理我的人就是 Geoffrey。而你也知道 Geoffrey 是什么样的人。

lines.en: {i}Hey! Narrator again. Just figured I'd clue you in on Geoffrey since you haven't had the pleasure of meeting him yet.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}嘿！又是我，旁白。想着你还没机会认识 Geoffrey，就来给你补充点情报。{/i}

lines.en: {i}He's actually a really great guy if you can look past all the scars!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}只要你能忽略那些疤痕，他其实是个非常好的人！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Geoffrey is an American immigrant who works and lives in the Amamiya mansion.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Geoffrey 是一名在 Amamiya 宅邸工作并居住的美国移民。{/i}

lines.en: {i}His family was brutally murdered many years ago and he is currently working as a butler while devising a plan to avenge them!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}他的家人在许多年前惨遭杀害，如今他一边当管家，一边策划着为他们复仇！{/i}

lines.en: {i}But that's all I'm allowed to tell you for now since I signed an NDA!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}不过因为我签了保密协议（NDA），现在能告诉你的就只有这些了！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Don't worry, though! You can find out more by preordering the upcoming Lessons in Love expansion pack, “A World Without Geoffrey’s Family!”{/i}
lines.zh: {i}别担心！预购即将推出的 Lessons in Love 资料片《没有 Geoffrey 家人的世界！》就能了解更多。{/i}

lines.en: {i}And if you pre-order your copy from GameStop today, you'll unlock three bonus coffins for Geoffrey’s wife!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}而且如果你今天从 GameStop 预购，还能解锁 Geoffrey 妻子的三口奖励棺材。{/i}

lines.en: scene sleepover19
: Geoffrey! I miss him. How is he doing?
lines.zh: : Geoffrey！我好想他。他最近怎么样？

lines.en: : Did he ever get that thing with the Irish mafia sorted out?
lines.zh: : 他跟爱尔兰黑手党那档子事解决了吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, I remember him being really intense about it the last time I came over.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我记得上次去的时候他还为这事特别上心。

lines.en: : I think so. He disappeared for a few days a month or two ago and came back covered in blood, but he seems fine now.
lines.zh: : 应该解决了吧。一两个月前他失踪了几天，回来的时候浑身是血，不过现在看起来没事了。

lines.en: scene sleepover23
: And on that note, I'm hungry.
lines.zh: : 说到这儿，我饿了。

lines.en: : Blood made you hungry?
lines.zh: : 血让你饿了？

lines.en: : Everything makes me hungry. Were we still planning on going to that cafe Rin works at?
lines.zh: : 什么都让我饿。我们还打算去 Rin 打工的那家咖啡厅吗？

lines.en: : Didn’t you just eat karaage at the karaoke place like, two hours ago? Can't we wait a little longer?
lines.zh: : 你不是两小时前才在卡拉OK店吃了唐扬鸡块吗？就不能再等一会儿吗？

lines.en: : Ami, I’m really going to need you to stop judging me if this friendship is going to continue.
lines.zh: : Ami，你要是还想让这段友谊继续下去，就真的别再对我指指点点了。

lines.en: : Just eat something here. It's basically your house too, so you can help yourself to anything you can find in the fridge or the pantry.
lines.zh: : 就在这儿吃点什么吧。这里基本也算你家，冰箱和储藏室里有什么你随便吃。

lines.en: : I hope you realize how dangerous what you just said to me is.
lines.zh: : 你知不知道你刚才对我说的这句话有多危险。

lines.en: scene sleepover24
: I can heat something up for Maya. I have to get up to go to the bathroom anyway.
lines.zh: : 我可以给 Maya 热点东西。我反正也得起来去趟洗手间。

lines.en: : Can you microwave some popcorn while you're in the kitchen as well? Sensei says that watching a movie without popcorn is a sin and I don't want God to kill me.
lines.zh: : 你在厨房的时候能不能顺便微波点爆米花？Sensei 说看电影不吃爆米花是一种罪，我可不想被上帝弄死。

lines.en: : I second the popcorn motion, but for reasons not pertaining to any higher power.
lines.zh: : 我附议爆米花的提案，不过我的理由与任何更高的存在无关。

lines.en: scene black
: Yup! I'll be back in a few, so don't miss me too much!
lines.zh: : 好嘞！我一会儿就回来，所以别太想我哦！

lines.en: : Bring drinks too. As quickly as possible. I require all of them.
lines.zh: : 饮料也顺便带过来。越快越好。我全都要。

lines.en: : Maybe we should just buy a second fridge for you to use whenever you come over?...
lines.zh: : 要不我们干脆再买一台冰箱，专门给你来的时候用？……

lines.en: {i}Roughly thirty seconds later...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}大约三十秒后……{/i}

lines.en: scene newchu1
: Wha-
: Oh. Hey, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 哦。嗨，Ayane。

lines.en: : The bathroom is in use right now.
lines.zh: : 洗手间现在有人。

lines.en: scene newchu2
scene newchu1
scene newchu3
: That...
: That's a really big penis...
lines.zh: : 那根鸡巴真大啊……

lines.en: : Thanks. I appreciate that.
lines.zh: : 谢谢。我很感激你这么说。

lines.en: scene newchu4
: Okay. I'm gonna go die now.
lines.zh: : 好吧。我现在要去死了。

lines.en: : Okay. I'll be out of here in a few minutes if you need to use the bathroom.
lines.zh: : 好吧。我几分钟后就出来，你要用洗手间的话就等着。

lines.en: : You can't pee when you're dead, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 死人可是尿不出来的，Sensei。

lines.en: scene newchu5
: No...No, I guess you can't.
lines.zh: : 不……不，我想确实尿不出来。

lines.en: scene black
{i}Several seconds later...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}几秒之后……{/i}

lines.en: scene newchu6

: OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD OHMYGOD.
lines.zh: : 我的天啊我的天啊我的天啊我的天啊我的天啊我的天啊我的天啊我的天啊我的天啊我的天啊我的天啊我的天啊我的天啊我的天啊我的天啊我的天啊我的天啊我的天啊我的天啊我的天啊我的天啊我的天啊我的天啊我的天啊我的天啊我的天啊我的天啊我的天啊我的天啊我的天啊我的天啊我的天啊我的天啊我的天啊.

lines.en: : That happened. That just happened. I saw it. I actually saw it. He saw me see it. I saw him see me see it. Oh my god.
lines.zh: : 发生了。刚才那真的发生了。我看见了。我真的看见了。他看见我看见了。我看见他看见我看见了。我的天啊。

lines.en: : How long did I stare for? Seconds? Minutes? Days? What time is it? What am I doing here? Who am I?
lines.zh: : 我盯着看了多久？几秒？几分钟？几天？现在几点？我在这儿干什么？我是谁？

lines.en: : All I know is penis. All I know is penis. All I know is penis. All I know is-
lines.zh: : 我只知道鸡巴。我只知道鸡巴。我只知道鸡巴。我只知道——

lines.en: : Uhh...what the fuck are you doing?
lines.zh: : 呃……你到底在搞什么鬼？

lines.en: scene newchu7
: I don't know anymore, Maya.
lines.zh: : 我不知道了，Maya。

lines.en: : It happened so quickly...I couldn't even think straight.
lines.zh: : 发生得太快了……我根本来不及思考。

lines.en: : It's like...my mind was telling me to move forward. But before I knew it, I was out here in the hallway again...contemplating life and what has become of me.
lines.zh: : 就好像……我的大脑在叫我往前走。但我回过神来的时候，人已经在走廊上了……思考着人生，以及我到底变成了什么。

lines.en: : You were gone for literally two minutes.
lines.zh: : 你总共就去了两分钟。

lines.en: scene newchu8
: That's it?! It felt like I was in there for days!
lines.zh: : 就两分钟？！我感觉自己在里面待了好几天！

lines.en: : Okay well, you're being gross and I'm just going to make my own food because this is obviously about something I am very much not interested in.
lines.zh: : 行吧，你现在这样很恶心，我要自己去做吃的了，因为这事显然跟我完全无关。

lines.en: : Will you sleep next to me tonight? I don't know if I'll be able to fall asleep if I'm by myself. I just...keep seeing it. It's in my head, Maya. {i}It's in my head.{/i}
lines.zh: : 今晚你能挨着我睡吗？我怕自己一个人睡不着。我……一直看见那东西。它在我的脑子里，Maya。{i}它在我的脑子里{/i}。

lines.en: : What is in your head? What are you- oh.
lines.zh: : 什么东西在你的脑子里？你在说什——哦。

lines.en: scene newchu9
: Do you...think Ami has also seen-
lines.zh: : 你……觉得 Ami 是不是也看过——

lines.en: : Shut up. Shut up, shut up, shut up. I never heard this and I am now going to go back to the reason I came out here.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴。闭嘴，闭嘴，闭嘴。我从没听过这些，现在我要回到我出来的正事上去了。

lines.en: : Goodbye and please don't ever bring this up again. Thanks.
lines.zh: : 再见，还有求你以后别再提起这件事了。谢谢。

lines.en: : Oh my god...Oh my god...Oh my god...
lines.zh: : 我的天啊……我的天啊……我的天啊……

lines.en: : Oh my god...
lines.zh: : 我的天啊……

lines.en: scene black
{i}And that was the first time Ayane ever saw a penis in real life...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}这就是 Ayane 第一次在现实中看到鸡巴……{/i}

lines.en: {i}Some say, she's still immobilized outside of that bathroom door to this very day...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}有人说，直到今天她仍僵在那扇洗手间门外……{/i}

lines.en: label afterbrscene:
scene bedroom_night
I walk into my room and immediately collapse onto the bed.
lines.zh: 我走进自己的房间，一头栽倒在床上。

lines.en: I have no idea what the future implications of Ayane walking in on me are but, if there is {i}anyone{/i} that is bound to be okay with something like that, it's her.
lines.zh: 我不知道 Ayane 撞见我这件事今后会带来什么影响，不过如果说{i}有谁{/i}对这种事肯定无所谓，那就是她了。

lines.en: I can't say I expected her to just run away, though. And, who knows? Maybe if she actually knew what she was walking into, she wouldn't have run at all.
lines.zh: 但我没料到她会直接跑掉。而且，谁知道呢？也许要是她进来前知道会撞见什么，她根本就不会跑了。

lines.en: Regardless, I have no regrets and I am glad we got this out of the way sooner rather than later.
lines.zh: 无论如何，我不后悔，而且我很高兴我们早点把这一关给过了。

lines.en: Because even if nothing comes of it, I know for a fact that the image of me is now engraved into her mind.
lines.zh: 因为就算最后什么都没发生，我也确信我的形象已经刻进她的脑子里了。

lines.en: Either way, my new life of attempted debauchery and depravity begins tomorrow.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我那充满放荡与堕落的崭新人生，从明天正式开始。

lines.en: Ayane just happened to get a bit of a head start to the party.
lines.zh: Ayane 只不过碰巧提前抢跑了这场派对。

lines.en: scene black
Goodnight, world.
lines.zh: 晚安，世界。

lines.en: Please keep whatever dreams you were thinking of gracing me with to yourself, for I am about to fall asleep {i}in{/i} one-
lines.zh: 请把你原本打算恩赐给我的那些梦都留给自己吧，因为我即将{i}坠入{/i}一个——

lines.en: One that I will hopefully remain in forever.
lines.zh: 一个我希望能永远沉睡其中的梦。

lines.en: I will make the most of this life.
lines.zh: 我会好好利用这辈子。

lines.en: I will live for myself.
lines.zh: 我会为自己而活。

lines.en: And if others get hurt in the process, I will do what I do best and write them off.
lines.zh: 如果有别人在这个过程中受伤，我会拿出我最擅长的本事，把他们一笔勾销。

lines.en: A voice in the back of my mind reminds me that none of this is real.
lines.zh: 脑海深处有个声音提醒我，这一切都不是真的。

lines.en: A second one fights against it.
lines.zh: 第二个声音反驳着它。

lines.en: A third carries me off to sleep.
lines.zh: 第三个声音带我坠入睡眠。

lines.en: $ sleepover = True
{i}From this point on, you will be able to make decisions that will impact your relationships with every character in the game.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}从现在开始，你将能够做出影响你与游戏中每个角色关系的决定。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Weekends will give you a morning, afternoon, and night phase.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}周末会分为早晨、下午和夜晚三个阶段。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Each phase gives you time to hang out with one girl. But each girl is only available at specific times in specific places each day.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}每个阶段你都有时间和一个女孩相处。但每个女孩每天只在特定的时间出现在特定的地点。{/i}

lines.en: {i}You will eventually have the option to call the girls and bypass this, but you must first acquire their phone numbers.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你最终会解锁给女孩打电话、跳过这一步的选项，但你必须先拿到她们的电话号码。{/i}

lines.en: {i}You will soon find that certain actions or certain events will require you to be in the right place at the right time.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你很快就会发现，某些行动或某些事件需要你在正确的时间出现在正确的地点。{/i}

lines.en: {i}And if you get lost, remember that's exactly where I want you.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}而如果你迷路了，请记住那正是我想要的。{/i}

lines.en: {i}On school days, you will only be able to act freely at night. The morning and afternoon will be consumed by class and counseling.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}上学日你只能在夜晚自由行动。早晨和下午会被上课和辅导占满。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Remember, many events in this game will be locked behind others. Focusing on one character is both not advised and not possible.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}记住，本作中有许多事件都是层层解锁的。专注攻略一个角色既不明智，也不可行。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Oh, but remember this more than anything else-{/i}
lines.zh: {i}哦，但下面这句话比什么都更重要——{/i}

lines.en: {i}This world was made for you.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}这个世界是为你而造的。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Please enjoy it to your heart’s content.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}请尽情享受它吧。{/i}
